title: In Search of Lehi’s Trail
author: Lynn M. and Hope A. Hilton

footnotes.text: Nephi’s sisters (2 Ne. 5:6) are unnamed in the Book of Mormon. We do not know if these were Nephi’s older sisters or younger sisters born at Jerusalem, in the wilderness, or in the promised land.

§ Whether Jacob and Joseph were born at the Valley of Lemuel we do not know. They are not mentioned in the Book of Mormon until the departure from Bountiful, some ten years after Lehi left Jerusalem. (1 Ne. 18:7.)
